test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Our environment is facing a severe crisis like never before. Any recklessness in this regard could prove __________ to life on Earth.
solution:
The correct answer is '**fatal**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**fatal**" means causing death. (घातक)
 
• In the context of environmental crisis, recklessness could lead to fatal consequences for life on Earth.
 
• The other options: "**bland**," "**harmless**," and "**innocuous**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Our environment is facing a severe crisis like never before. Any recklessness in this regard could prove fatal__ to life on Earth.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bland (निष्‍प्रभ)**: means lacking strong features or characteristics and therefore uninteresting.
 
• **Harmless (हानिरहित)**: means not able or likely to cause harm.
 
• **Innocuous (अहानिकर)**: means not harmful or offensive.
